agent-task.objective:
# Generate a bust-up portrait for the SnakeStick app icon
## Background - SnakeStick is a macOS app that creates Windows USB installers. Its mascot is a snake-kin woman holding an apple: the serpent of Eden offering the forbidden fruit (the apple also nods to the Mac). - The image will be composited onto a background color chosen later and cropped into an app icon. Only the character is needed.
## Scope - One image: a bust-up portrait (head to upper chest) of the character described in . - Portrait orientation, 2:3, 1024 x 1536 px, PNG with a fully transparent background.
## Out of scope - Background, scenery, frame, icon shape (squircle), text, logo. The icon is assembled separately.
agent-task.decisions: Settled with the client. Do not reinterpret or "improve" these. - D1. Japanese anime / subculture character. A snake-kin woman, apparent age late 30s. - D2. Snake traits are moderate: slit pupils, patches of scales, one fang. No cobra hood, no visible tail. - D3. The outfit reads as a villainous boss: black, elegant, high-collared. - D4. Black hair with a crimson inner color (hidden underlayer), modeled on the red-bellied black snake. - D5. Maturity cues: a beauty mark under one eye, dark lipstick, a sharp jawline. - D6. Expression: confident, slightly wicked, barely smiling. Closed-lip smirk with one fang tip showing. - D7. The apple is whole and unbitten, with no leaf. A bitten apple evokes the Apple logo.
agent-task.specs:
§1 Face and age (D1, D5) - A woman in her late 30s. Mature anime proportions: a longer face, defined cheekbones, a sharp jawline, narrower almond-shaped eyes. No childlike or teenage features, no large round eyes. - A small beauty mark (tear mole) just below the outer corner of one eye. - Dark burgundy / deep crimson lipstick. Sharp winged eyeliner, long lashes.
§2 Eyes and expression (D6) - Crimson red irises with vertical slit pupils, clearly visible. Heavy-lidded, half-closed eyes. - Chin slightly lowered, looking straight at the viewer from under her lashes. - Asymmetric closed-lip smirk: one mouth corner raised. The tip of one small fang peeks over the lower lip at the raised corner. Not a grin, not laughing, mouth closed, no tongue. - Mood: amused, self-assured, quietly tempting.
§3 Hair (D4) - Long, straight, glossy black hair, side-parted, falling past the shoulders. Ears hidden by hair. - Crimson inner color: the underside layer is vivid crimson, visible where the hair parts, at the nape, and where locks flip over the shoulders. The outer surface stays black. - Highlights on the black hair are neutral or warm. No blue highlights.
§4 Snake traits (D2) - Small patches of glossy black scales with faint crimson edges: at the outer corners of the eyes and temples, along one cheekbone, down the side of the neck, and on the back of the visible hand. - Scales are accents, not a full covering. Skin is fair. - Dark, slightly pointed nails (black or deep crimson).
§5 Outfit (D3) - A black, long-sleeved, high-collared fitted dress with a subtle snakeskin texture in the fabric. - One small crimson gemstone brooch at the collar. No other visible jewelry. - Cropped at the upper chest. Elegant and restrained.
§6 Apple and hand (D7) - One glossy, vivid red whole apple with a short brown stem and no leaf. - Held in one hand, raised beside her face at cheek-to-chin height, slightly extended toward the viewer as an offering. - Exactly one hand visible, five slender fingers, anatomically correct. The hand does not cover the face.
§7 Composition (see code#layout) - 3/4 view: body turned slightly, face toward the viewer. - The face and the apple both sit inside the top 1024 x 1024 px region, so a square crop yields a complete icon. - Margin above the hair and on both sides. The bottom edge cuts the body at the upper chest.
§8 Art style - Modern Japanese anime illustration. Cel shading with 2-3 tone steps, clean, confident line art. - Must stay legible at 64 px: strong silhouette, clear value separation between face, hair and apple, no busy fine detail. - Limited palette: black, crimson, fair skin, small white highlights. Approximate anchors: black #0E0B10, crimson #B3122E, apple red #D7263D.
§9 Output - 1024 x 1536 px, portrait 2:3, PNG with a real alpha channel. - Fully transparent (alpha 0) everywhere outside the character.
agent-task.code: +--------------------------------+ y = 0 | top margin | | .------------. | | / black hair \ | | | slit eyes | (O) | <- apple at cheek height, | | tear mole | hand | offered toward the viewer | \ smirk+fang / | | hair \ sharp jaw / hair | | (crimson underside visible) | |================================| y = 1024: face and apple must be above this line | high black collar | | shoulders / upper chest | +--------------------------------+ y = 1536, body cropped by the edge
agent-task.constraints: Failures that look fine at a glance: - Fake transparency: a painted grey/white checkerboard, or a white or grey backdrop instead of real alpha. - Drop shadow, glow, rim-light halo, particles, smoke or vignette outside the silhouette. Anything semi-transparent around the figure breaks compositing. - Age drift. Anime women default to their early 20s. Keep every §1 maturity cue visible. - A bitten apple, an apple with a leaf, or an apple silhouette that resembles a logo. - Blue highlights on the black hair. - Fine flyaway strands at the silhouette edge. They become fringe on alpha. Keep hair outlines clean. - Extra fingers, a second hand, or an apple floating without being held. - Any text, signature, watermark or UI element.
agent-task.acceptance: Check each item before returning: 1. 1024 x 1536, portrait. The background is true alpha, with no checkerboard pixels. 2. The face and the apple are both within the top 1024 x 1024 region. 3. Slit pupils, crimson irises, beauty mark, dark lipstick and one fang tip are all visible. 4. The crimson inner color shows in the hair. The outer hair is black. 5. One whole red apple, no bite, no leaf, held by one correctly drawn hand. 6. She reads as a woman in her late 30s, not a teenager. 7. Downscaled to 64 px, the face, the red eyes and the apple are still recognizable.
agent-task.closing: - Return one image only. - If this environment cannot output a real alpha channel, say so explicitly and use a flat, solid #00FF00 background instead. Do not simulate transparency. - If any acceptance item was not met, list it in one line after the image. Do not claim it was met.
